An authentication issue was addressed with improved state management. This issue is fixed in macOS Sequoia 15.7.9, macOS Sonoma 14.8.9, macOS Tahoe 26.6.1. An attacker on the network may be able to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.
VMware vCenter contains a directory traversal vulnerability in the Syslog server. A malicious actor with network access to vCenter may exploit this issue to execute arbitrary code.
Double free in Windows IKE Extension allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

A flaw was found in the Keycloak Admin REST API, which is used to manage security realms and clients. The issue occurs when the system processes requests for rotated client secrets that are stored in a secure vault. Due to improper boundary enforcement, a delegated administrator with view-only permissions can retrieve the actual resolved secret instead of the vault placeholder, leading to the exposure of sensitive credentials.

A vulnerability was discovered in Keycloak's administrative interface that allows certain administrators to see information about groups they shouldn't have access to. When the new Fine-Grained Admin Permissions (FGAP v2) are turned on, an administrator who is allowed to see a specific "role" can also see a list of all groups assigned to that role. The system fails to check if the administrator has permission to see those specific groups. This could allow a restricted administrator to discover "hidden" groups and see their details, such as internal names and custom settings, which might contain sensitive deployment information.

A flaw was found in Keycloak. An authenticated administrator with the `manage-clients` role can exploit a Time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) vulnerability in the name-based admin role checks. This allows the attacker to escalate their privileges to `realm-admin` for all users within the realm, granting them extensive control over the system. The composite role relationship persists even after the attacker's own permissions are revoked and across system reboots.

A vulnerability has been found in SourceCodester Simple Online Food Ordering System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file /admin/ajax.php?action=save_menu. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

A flaw has been found in SourceCodester Simple Online Food Ordering System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /admin/ajax.php?action=login. Executing a manipulation of the argument Username can lead to sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used.

A flaw was found in the Tempo Operator. When the Jaeger UI Monitor Tab functionality is enabled in a Tempo instance managed by the Tempo Operator, the Operator creates a ClusterRoleBinding for the Service Account of the Tempo instance to grant the cluster-monitoring-view ClusterRole.
This can be exploited if a user has 'create' permissions on TempoStack and 'get' permissions on Secret in a namespace (for example, a user has ClusterAdmin permissions for a specific namespace), as the user can read the token of the Tempo service account and therefore has access to see all cluster metrics.

A flaw was found in Tempo Operator, where it creates a ServiceAccount, ClusterRole, and ClusterRoleBinding when a user deploys a TempoStack or TempoMonolithic instance. This flaw allows a user with full access to their namespace to extract the ServiceAccount token and use it to submit TokenReview and SubjectAccessReview requests, potentially revealing information about other users' permissions. While this does not allow privilege escalation or impersonation, it exposes information that could aid in gathering information for further attacks.

A vulnerability has been found in BusyBox up to 1.30.1. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file networking/wget.c of the component FEATURE_WGET_TIMEOUT Handler. Such manipulation of the argument -T leads to null pointer dereference. Local access is required to approach this attack. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The name of the patch is 83a40bf7a93c8ac093d33ab452222dd5b9eb57ff. A patch should be applied to remediate this issue.

A weakness has been identified in UTT HiPER 1200GW up to 2.5.3-170306. Affected is the function strcpy of the file /goform/formGroupConfig. Executing a manipulation of the argument timestart can lead to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

A heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability was found in the GStreamer gst-plugins-bad adpcmdec element when decoding IMA/DVI ADPCM audio. Insufficient validation of the per-block sample count for multi-channel streams allows a crafted WAV file to cause writes beyond the allocated output buffer. This can lead to application crash, denial of service, memory corruption, or potentially arbitrary code execution when untrusted media is processed.

A flaw was found in the legacy client-initiated account-linking endpoint of Keycloak, a widely used open-source identity and access management solution. The mechanism used to protect the account-linking process from unauthorized requests relies on a hash that can be predicted by a malicious OIDC client. By tricking a user into authenticating, an attacker-controlled client can forge a valid linking URL to connect the victim's account to an attacker's external identity. This results in a full account takeover, allowing the attacker to log in as the victim.

A flaw was found in the reset-credentials flow of the keycloak-services component, which is the core engine for identity and access management in Red Hat Build of Keycloak. The issue allows an unauthenticated attacker to force the password reset process for any user without needing to click the required email verification link. This can result in the attacker gaining full control over target user accounts by directly setting new credentials.

A vulnerability was found in SPLWare esProc up to 20260507. This affects the function ObjectInputStream.readUnshared of the file src/main/java/com/scudata/parallel/SocketData.java. Performing a manipulation results in deserialization. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible.

A flaw was found in the libssh library in versions less than 0.11.2. An out-of-bounds read can be triggered in the sftp_handle function due to an incorrect comparison check that permits the function to access memory beyond the valid handle list and to return an invalid pointer, which is used in further processing. This vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker to potentially read unintended memory regions, exposing sensitive information or affect service behavior.

A flaw was found in GNU Coreutils. The sort utility's begfield() function is vulnerable to a heap buffer under-read. The program may access memory outside the allocated buffer if a user runs a crafted command using the traditional key format. A malicious input could lead to a crash or leak sensitive data.

A vulnerability has been found in code-projects Online Job Portal System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /ForPass.php of the component Password Recovery. Such manipulation of the argument txtUserName leads to sql injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

The Speed Optimizer – The All-In-One Performance-Boosting Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Image Tag Attributes in all versions up to, and including, 7.8.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is only exploitable when the site administrator has enabled the Lazy Load Media option in the plugin settings.

A vulnerability has been identified in armeria-xds versions prior to 1.41.0, where xDS upstream TLS peer verification may be silently disabled, allowing man-in-the-middle attacks against xDS-managed upstream connections.

A vulnerability was found in xianrendzw EasyReport up to 2.0.17.0522_Beta. Affected is the function execSqlText/previewSqlText of the file DesignerController.java of the component SQL Preview Endpoint. The manipulation of the argument sqlText results in improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A flaw was found in the HAL Console in the Wildfly component, which does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output used as a web page that is served to other users. The attacker must be authenticated as a user that belongs to management groups “SuperUser”, “Admin”, or “Maintainer”.

A security flaw exists in WildFly and JBoss Enterprise Application Platform (EAP) within the Enterprise JavaBeans (EJB) remote invocation mechanism. This vulnerability stems from untrusted data deserialization handled by JBoss Marshalling. This flaw allows an attacker to send a specially crafted serialized object, leading to remote code execution without requiring authentication.

A vulnerability was found in Wildfly, where a user may perform Cross-site scripting in the Wildfly deployment system. This flaw allows an attacker or insider to execute a deployment with a malicious payload, which could trigger undesired behavior against the server.

The "stringprep" module didn't process characters from RFC 3454 tables 
B.2 or B.3 correctly: the latest Unicode codepoint attributes were used 
instead of the specified Unicode 3.2.0. This behavior would cause 
mismatches when processing domain names using IDNA 2003 (the "idna" 
codec) and the in_table_b2() function of the "stringprep" module. This 
only affects domain names containing characters that were not previously
 registered or had their Unicode attributes such as case-folding 
behavior updated since Unicode 3.2.0.

A flaw was found in libxslt where the attribute type, atype, flags are modified in a way that corrupts internal memory management. When XSLT functions, such as the key() process, result in tree fragments, this corruption prevents the proper cleanup of ID attributes. As a result, the system may access freed memory, causing crashes or enabling attackers to trigger heap corruption.

A vulnerability has been identified in the libarchive library, specifically within the archive_read_format_rar_seek_data() function. This flaw involves an integer overflow that can ultimately lead to a double-free condition. Exploiting a double-free vulnerability can result in memory corruption, enabling an attacker to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial-of-service condition.

ai.summary_en: This batch highlights critical cloud authentication bypasses in Azure services, severe RCE flaws in Windows and SharePoint, and significant vulnerabilities in IoT and middleware platforms. | This batch is dominated by high-severity Microsoft Windows and server vulnerabilities, featuring critical RCEs in RDP, SMB, and DHCP, alongside highly probable EoP exploits and severe SharePoint/Exchange flaws. | This batch is dominated by critical Microsoft vulnerabilities, including an actively exploited WinSock LPE, multiple CVSS 9.8 RCEs in Windows DNS and QUIC, and severe flaws in Exchange and SharePoint.
ai.summary_zh: 本批次重点披露了 Azure 服务中严重的云身份验证绕过漏洞、Windows 和 SharePoint 中的严重 RCE 漏洞，以及 IoT 和中间件平台中的重大漏洞。| 本批次以高危 Microsoft Windows 及服务器漏洞为主，涵盖 RDP、SMB 和 DHCP 中的严重 RCE 漏洞，以及极可能被利用的 EoP 漏洞和严重的 SharePoint/Exchange 漏洞。| 本批次主要涉及严重的 Microsoft 漏洞，包括一个正被在野利用的 WinSock LPE 漏洞、Windows DNS 和 QUIC 中多个 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的 RCE 漏洞，以及 Exchange 和 SharePoint 中的严重漏洞。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution vulnerability in Windows iSCSI Target Service with a CVSS of 9.8, allowing unauthenticated network attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI Target Service 中存在 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的严重远程代码执行漏洞，允许未经身份验证的网络攻击。

items.reason_en: Publicly disclosed elevation of privilege in Microsoft Defender (ShieldBreak), posing a significant risk to endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: 公开披露的 Microsoft Defender (ShieldBreak) 权限提升漏洞，对端点安全构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Remote Desktop Client RCE with a CVSS of 8.8 allows unauthorized network code execution, posing a severe risk to remote access infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的远程代码执行漏洞，允许未经授权的网络代码执行，对远程访问基础设施构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: EoP in Windows Accessibility Infrastructure has the highest EPSS (0.0368) in this batch, indicating a high likelihood of active exploitation in the wild.
items.reason_zh: Windows Accessibility Infrastructure 中的权限提升漏洞在此批次中具有最高的 EPSS 评分（0.0368），表明在野活跃利用的可能性很高。

items.reason_en: Win32K EoP vulnerability with a high EPSS score (0.0245), making it a prime candidate for post-exploitation privilege escalation chains.
items.reason_zh: Win32K 权限提升漏洞具有较高的 EPSS 评分（0.0245），使其成为漏洞利用后权限提升链的首选目标。

items.reason_en: User Profile Service EoP with an elevated EPSS (0.0237) presents a significant and probable local privilege escalation risk.
items.reason_zh: User Profile Service 权限提升漏洞具有较高的 EPSS 评分（0.0237），存在重大且极有可能发生的本地权限提升风险。

items.reason_en: Listed in CISA KEV as actively exploited in the wild, this Windows WinSock driver privilege escalation requires immediate patching.
items.reason_zh: 该 Windows WinSock 驱动程序权限提升漏洞已被列入 CISA KEV 并在野活跃利用，需要立即修补。

items.reason_en: A critical CVSS 9.8 use-after-free vulnerability in Windows Deployment Services allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Windows Deployment Services 中存在 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的严重释放后使用漏洞，允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: An integer overflow in Microsoft Outlook allows remote code execution, posing a high risk via phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Outlook 中的整数溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，通过网络钓鱼活动构成高风险。

items.reason_en: Allows unauthorized remote code execution via a heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Remote Desktop Client, posing a significant risk to enterprise endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Windows Remote Desktop Client 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经授权的远程代码执行，对企业端点构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: A critical remote code execution vulnerability in IBM AIX and PowerVM VIOS due to improper validation of network-supplied pointers, threatening enterprise server infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 由于对网络提供的指针验证不当，IBM AIX 和 PowerVM VIOS 中存在严重的远程代码执行漏洞，威胁企业服务器基础设施。

items.reason_en: A critical CVSS 10 vulnerability in Ozols Grupa OZOLS on Windows leverages an abandoned auto-update domain to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Windows 平台上的 Ozols Grupa OZOLS 中存在 CVSS 评分为 10 的严重漏洞，利用废弃的自动更新域名实现未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Allows an attacker with AD GPO management access to inject sudoRole objects and escalate to root privileges on Linux systems via SSSD.
items.reason_zh: 允许具有 AD GPO 管理访问权限的攻击者注入 sudoRole 对象，并通过 SSSD 在 Linux 系统上提升至 root 权限。

items.reason_en: A flaw in Vim's netrw plugin allows arbitrary Vimscript and shell command execution via crafted filenames during mark/unmark operations.

items.reason_en: A KVM SVM virtualization vulnerability involving x2APIC MSR intercepts that could allow guest-to-host interference in cloud environments.
items.reason_zh: KVM SVM 虚拟化中存在一个涉及 x2APIC MSR 拦截的漏洞，可能导致云环境中的虚拟机到宿主机的干扰。

items.reason_en: A flaw in KVM s390 PCI adapter interrupt forwarding that could disrupt virtualized mainframe cloud infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: KVM s390 PCI 适配器中断转发中存在一个缺陷，可能会破坏虚拟化的大型机云基础设施。

items.reason_en: A maximum severity (CVSS 10) improper access control flaw in Azure Cosmos DB enabling remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Azure Cosmos DB 中存在一个最高严重级别（CVSS 10）的不当访问控制缺陷，可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A critical CVSS 10 improper authentication vulnerability in Azure Key Vault allowing network-based privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault 中存在一个严重的 CVSS 10 不当身份验证漏洞，允许基于网络的权限提升。

items.reason_en: A CVSS 9.9 deserialization vulnerability in M365 Copilot that allows authorized attackers to execute code over the network.
items.reason_zh: M365 Copilot 中存在一个 CVSS 9.9 的反序列化漏洞，允许已授权攻击者通过网络执行代码。

items.reason_en: A critical use-after-free in Windows VMSwitch (Hyper-V) allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges, threatening cloud and virtualization infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows VMSwitch (Hyper-V) 中存在一个严重的释放后使用漏洞，允许已授权攻击者提升权限，威胁云和虚拟化基础设施。

items.reason_en: A critical Hyper-V remote code execution vulnerability that allows a guest VM to execute code on the host, posing a massive risk to cloud and virtualized infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 中存在一个严重的远程代码执行漏洞，允许客户虚拟机在宿主机上执行代码，对云和虚拟化基础设施构成巨大风险。

items.reason_en: A critical flaw in the Linux kernel's libceph CRUSH map decoding that can lead to memory corruption, threatening the stability of cloud-native distributed storage clusters.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核的 libceph CRUSH map 解码中存在一个严重缺陷，可导致内存损坏，威胁云原生分布式存储集群的稳定性。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Hyper-V that could allow privilege escalation, posing a significant risk of virtual machine escape in cloud environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中存在一个基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可能导致权限提升，在云环境中构成虚拟机逃逸的重大风险。

items.reason_en: High-severity KVM nVMX use-after-free vulnerability affecting virtualized environments and hypervisor stability.
items.reason_zh: KVM nVMX 中存在一个高严重级别的释放后使用漏洞，影响虚拟化环境和虚拟机管理程序的稳定性。

items.reason_en: KVM x86 MMU page fault handling issue that could impact virtual machine stability and isolation in cloud infrastructures.
items.reason_zh: KVM x86 MMU 缺页处理存在问题，可能影响云基础设施中虚拟机的稳定性和隔离性。

items.reason_en: An information disclosure vulnerability in Azure AD that can expose unprotected private key data, risking cloud identity and application compromise.
items.reason_zh: Azure AD 中存在一个信息泄露漏洞，可能暴露未受保护的私钥数据，带来云身份和应用程序被攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Power Platform allows unauthenticated attackers to view sensitive information over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Power Platform 中存在授权缺失漏洞，允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过网络查看敏感信息。

items.reason_en: A CVSS 8.8 elevation of privilege vulnerability in Azure Stack HCI, threatening the security of hyperconverged cloud infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure Stack HCI 中存在一个 CVSS 8.8 的权限提升漏洞，威胁超融合云基础设施的安全。

items.reason_en: A critical CVSS 9.0 remote code execution flaw in Hyper-V VMBus that could allow attackers to compromise cloud and virtualization hosts.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V VMBus 中存在一个严重的 CVSS 9.0 远程代码执行缺陷，可能允许攻击者攻陷云和虚拟化宿主机。

items.reason_en: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Azure CLI that could allow unauthorized access to cloud management resources.
items.reason_zh: Azure CLI 中存在一个权限提升漏洞，可能允许未经授权访问云管理资源。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure CycleCloud allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 的关键功能存在身份验证缺失，允许已授权攻击者通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Critical elevation of privilege vulnerability in Azure App Service on Azure Stack Hub, threatening cloud infrastructure isolation.
items.reason_zh: Azure Stack Hub 上的 Azure App Service 中存在严重的权限提升漏洞，威胁云基础设施的隔离性。

items.reason_en: Critical CVSS 9.8 deserialization flaw in Azure SDK allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure SDK 中存在一个严重的 CVSS 9.8 反序列化缺陷，允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过网络执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Critical CVSS 9.8 elevation of privilege vulnerability in Azure Front Door poses a severe risk to cloud infrastructure routing.
items.reason_zh: Azure Front Door 中存在一个严重的 CVSS 9.8 权限提升漏洞，对云基础设施路由构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: High-severity improper access control in Azure Arc allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中存在高严重级别的不当访问控制漏洞，允许未经授权的攻击者通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Maximum severity missing authentication flaw in Azure Kubernetes Service allowing unauthorized privilege escalation over the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中存在最高严重级别的身份验证缺失缺陷，允许未经授权的攻击者通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Critical SSRF vulnerability in Azure OpenAI enabling authorized attackers to escalate privileges and potentially access internal cloud resources.
items.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 中存在严重的 SSRF 漏洞，使已授权攻击者能够提升权限并可能访问内部云资源。

items.reason_en: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management for Kubernetes allows cluster admins to specify unvalidated image paths in Submariner CRs. This lack of validation can lead to arbitrary code execution within the cluster.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management for Kubernetes 允许集群管理员在 Submariner CR 中指定未经验证的镜像路径。这种缺乏验证的情况可能导致集群内的任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: AWX contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in its GitHub webhook status callback mechanism. Attackers can exploit this to scan internal networks or access cloud metadata services.
items.reason_zh: AWX 的 GitHub webhook 状态回调机制中存在服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞。攻击者可利用此漏洞扫描内部网络或访问云元数据服务。

items.reason_en: Insufficient validation in Red Hat OpenShift Route resources allows attackers to inject malicious HAProxy configurations, potentially compromising cluster routing and security.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat OpenShift Route 资源验证不足，允许攻击者注入恶意 HAProxy 配置，可能破坏集群路由和安全性。

items.reason_en: Improper validation in Red Hat Open Cluster Management allows managed cluster administrators to forge client certificates and escalate privileges across the cluster.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Open Cluster Management 中存在验证不当漏洞，允许受管集群管理员伪造客户端证书并在整个集群内提升权限。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass in OpenStack's OAuth 2.0 middleware allows attackers to forge tokens and gain unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: OpenStack 的 OAuth 2.0 中间件中存在严重的身份验证绕过漏洞，允许攻击者伪造令牌并获取未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Allows attackers to exploit the OpenShift Router to proxy requests to cloud metadata endpoints, potentially leaking sensitive cloud credentials.
items.reason_zh: 允许攻击者利用 OpenShift Router 将请求代理到云元数据端点，可能导致敏感的云凭证泄露。

items.reason_en: Listed in CISA KEV, this critical directory traversal flaw in VMware vCenter's Syslog server allows network-accessible attackers to execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞已列入 CISA KEV，VMware vCenter 的 Syslog 服务器中存在严重的目录遍历缺陷，允许网络可达的攻击者执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: A privilege escalation flaw in Red Hat's multicloud-operators-subscription allows managed cluster users to deploy resources across any namespace.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat 的 multicloud-operators-subscription 中存在权限提升缺陷，允许受管集群用户在任何命名空间中部署资源。

items.reason_en: An authentication bypass in the vLLM inference engine exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs to unauthorized users, risking data leakage and resource abuse.
items.reason_zh: vLLM 推理引擎中存在身份验证绕过漏洞，使未经授权的用户能够访问兼容 OpenAI 的 API，带来数据泄露和资源滥用的风险。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated denial-of-service vulnerability affecting multiple TP-Link router models due to improper request handling.
items.reason_zh: 由于请求处理不当，多款 TP-Link 路由器型号受到影响，存在未经身份验证的拒绝服务漏洞。

items.reason_en: Windows DHCP Server heap-based buffer overflow (CVSS 8.8) allows RCE over an adjacent network, risking core network service compromise.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞（CVSS 8.8），允许在相邻网络上执行远程代码，危及核心网络服务。

items.reason_en: Windows SMB Server RCE (CVSS 8.8) is a critical network-accessible vulnerability that could lead to widespread lateral movement and wormable attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB Server 远程代码执行漏洞（CVSS 8.8）是一个严重的网络可达漏洞，可能导致大范围的横向移动和蠕虫式攻击。

items.reason_en: iSCSI Target Service RCE (CVSS 8.1) exposes network storage services to unauthorized remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: iSCSI Target Service 远程代码执行漏洞（CVSS 8.1）使网络存储服务面临未经授权的网络远程代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: A critical CVSS 9.8 stack-based buffer overflow in Windows DNS allows unauthenticated remote code execution on domain controllers.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中存在严重的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞（CVSS 9.8），允许在域控制器上执行未经身份验证的远程代码。

items.reason_en: A critical CVSS 9.8 use-after-free in Microsoft QUIC enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 中存在严重的释放后使用漏洞（CVSS 9.8），允许在网络上执行未经身份验证的远程代码。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the core Windows TCP/IP stack allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 核心 Windows TCP/IP 协议栈中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许执行未经身份验证的远程代码。

items.reason_en: Allows unauthenticated attackers to upload and install unsigned firmware on Netis NC63 routers, leading to complete device takeover and persistent backdoors.
items.reason_zh: 允许未经身份验证的攻击者在 Netis NC63 路由器上上传并安装未签名的固件，导致设备被完全接管并留下持久化后门。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in TRENDnet TV-IP751WIC IP cameras allows remote attackers to execute code or crash the device.
items.reason_zh: TRENDnet TV-IP751WIC IP 摄像头中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行代码或使设备崩溃。

items.reason_en: Cisco Crosswork received a critical software hardening release addressing multiple internally discovered vulnerabilities with a maximum CVSS score.
items.reason_zh: Cisco Crosswork 发布了关键的软件加固版本，修复了多个内部发现的具有最高 CVSS 评分的漏洞。

items.reason_en: An XXE vulnerability in the Cisco BroadWorks XML parser allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read sensitive system configuration information.
items.reason_zh: Cisco BroadWorks XML 解析器中存在 XXE 漏洞，允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者读取敏感的系统配置信息。

items.reason_en: Cisco Crosswork contains multiple critical vulnerabilities discovered during an internal security review, requiring immediate patching to prevent full compromise.
items.reason_zh: Cisco Crosswork 包含在内部安全审查期间发现的多个严重漏洞，需要立即修补以防止系统被完全攻陷。

items.reason_en: Cisco Secure Workload is affected by multiple critical flaws that could lead to complete system takeover and workload manipulation.
items.reason_zh: Cisco Secure Workload 受到多个严重缺陷的影响，可能导致系统被完全接管和工作负载被篡改。

items.reason_en: An unauthenticated attacker can send a malformed request to the IBM Power Systems ASMI web interface to achieve arbitrary code execution on the FSP.
items.reason_zh: 未经身份验证的攻击者可以向 IBM Power Systems ASMI Web 界面发送畸形请求，从而在 FSP 上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: A critical CVSS 10.0 vulnerability in the VXLAN network virtualization component that could lead to severe network stack compromise.
items.reason_zh: VXLAN 网络虚拟化组件中存在严重的漏洞（CVSS 10.0），可能导致网络协议栈被严重攻陷。

items.reason_en: A CVSS 9.8 flaw in the netfilter SIP connection tracking NAT rewrite logic, posing a significant risk to network firewalls and routers.
items.reason_zh: netfilter SIP 连接跟踪 NAT 重写逻辑中存在缺陷（CVSS 9.8），对网络防火墙和路由器构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: A CVSS 9.8 use-after-free vulnerability in the Linux kernel network bridge multicast fast-leave path, threatening network infrastructure stability.
items.reason_zh: Linux kernel 网络桥接多播快速离开路径中存在释放后使用漏洞（CVSS 9.8），威胁网络基础设施的稳定性。

items.reason_en: A critical CVSS 9.8 Linux kernel SCTP vulnerability that silently skips authentication, allowing unauthenticated network traffic.
items.reason_zh: Linux kernel SCTP 中存在严重的漏洞（CVSS 9.8），会静默跳过身份验证，允许未经身份验证的网络流量通过。

items.reason_en: A CVSS 9.8 memory corruption issue in the Linux kernel AMT implementation due to improper skb header pointer handling.
items.reason_zh: 由于 skb 头部指针处理不当，Linux kernel AMT 实现中存在内存损坏问题（CVSS 9.8）。

items.reason_en: An origin validation error in Windows NAT allows unauthorized attackers to perform network spoofing on adjacent networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows NAT 中存在源验证错误，允许未经授权的攻击者在相邻网络上执行网络欺骗。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled resource consumption in Windows DHCP Server allows unauthorized attackers to cause a denial of service over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中存在不受控制的资源消耗漏洞，允许未经授权的攻击者通过网络引发拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: A critical remote code execution flaw in Windows DNS Server that allows unauthenticated attackers to compromise domain controllers and core network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中存在严重的远程代码执行缺陷，允许未经身份验证的攻击者攻陷域控制器和核心网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Windows DHCP Server enabling unauthenticated network-based code execution, threatening network address management services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，支持未经身份验证的基于网络的代码执行，威胁网络地址管理服务。

items.reason_zh: Linux kernel 的 Openvswitch 组件中存在严重的下溢漏洞，该组件广泛应用于软件定义网络和云基础设施。

items.reason_zh: Linux内核的X.25网络协议栈中存在严重的释放后使用漏洞，可能导致内核被攻陷及系统不稳定。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows DNS server allowing unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS服务器中存在释放后使用漏洞，允许未授权攻击者通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Improper validation of SMB2 compound requests in ksmbd, potentially allowing remote exploitation on network file shares.
items.reason_zh: ksmbd中对SMB2复合请求验证不当，可能允许攻击者对网络文件共享进行远程利用。

items.reason_en: A CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Windows DHCP Server that allows code execution over an adjacent network, threatening core network services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server中存在CVSS评分为8.8的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许攻击者在相邻网络执行代码，威胁核心网络服务。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS), which is critical for network edge and VPN routing devices.
items.reason_zh: Windows Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) 中存在远程代码执行漏洞，该服务对网络边缘和VPN路由设备至关重要。

items.reason_en: A critical CVSS 9.8 remote code execution flaw in Microsoft PEAP, severely impacting network authentication services and infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft PEAP中存在CVSS评分为9.8的严重远程代码执行漏洞，严重影响网络身份验证服务与基础设施。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) could allow attackers to compromise network routing infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) 中的远程代码执行漏洞可能允许攻击者攻陷网络路由基础设施。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited access control flaw in Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) enabling local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) 中存在正被在野利用的访问控制漏洞，可导致本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Critical CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Windows FTP Service allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Windows FTP Service中存在CVSS评分为9.8的严重堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: High-severity heap-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Domain Services enables unauthenticated remote code execution across the network.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services中存在高危堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许攻击者通过网络进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: SQL injection vulnerability in Dell OpenManage Enterprise allowing low-privileged remote attackers to expose sensitive network management information.
items.reason_zh: Dell OpenManage Enterprise中存在SQL注入漏洞，允许低权限远程攻击者窃取敏感的网络管理信息。

items.reason_zh: Dell OpenManage Enterprise中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞。低权限远程攻击者可利用该漏洞在管理设备上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Oracle Communications Unified Inventory Management has a critical security component flaw. It allows unauthenticated attackers with network access to compromise the system.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Communications Unified Inventory Management存在严重的安全组件漏洞，允许具有网络访问权限的未经身份验证的攻击者攻陷系统。

items.reason_en: Cudy WR3000 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability in the mesh MQTT interface, allowing authenticated attackers to execute commands with root privileges.
items.reason_zh: Cudy WR3000路由器的Mesh MQTT接口中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许经过身份验证的攻击者以root权限执行命令。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the HTTP handler of UTT HiPER 1250GW routers could allow remote attackers to crash the device or execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: UTT HiPER 1250GW路由器的HTTP处理程序中存在栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可能允许远程攻击者导致设备崩溃或执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Critical vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler edge devices, which are prime targets for threat actors to gain initial network access.
items.reason_zh: Citrix NetScaler边缘设备中存在严重漏洞，该类设备是威胁行为者获取初始网络访问权限的首要目标。

items.reason_en: A critical out-of-bounds write in Dell PowerStore SDNAS SMB/CIFS service enables unauthenticated remote code execution on enterprise storage arrays.

items.reason_en: Exposure of the cryptographic session key in Zabbix allows attackers to forge valid frontend sessions and take over network monitoring infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Zabbix中存在加密会话密钥泄露问题，允许攻击者伪造有效的前端会话并接管网络监控基础设施。

items.reason_zh: 基于Web的SCADA/HMI软件FUXA存在身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未授权访问工业控制面板及执行操作。

items.reason_zh: CAN总线ISO-TP协议实现中存在竞争条件漏洞，可能危及汽车与工业控制系统的通信安全。

items.reason_en: FAYDAM Datalogger contains a critical SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to manipulate or extract sensitive data from industrial logging systems.

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint leading to remote code execution over the network.

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in Microsoft Office SharePoint allowing authorized attackers to escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中存在服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，允许已授权攻击者提升权限。

items.reason_en: SharePoint deserialization RCE (CVSS 8.8) allows authorized attackers to execute code over the network, critically impacting enterprise collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint反序列化远程代码执行漏洞（CVSS 8.8）允许已授权攻击者通过网络执行代码，严重影响企业协作平台。

items.reason_en: Exchange Server authentication bypass (CVSS 8.0) could allow attackers to elevate privileges over the network, threatening core email infrastructure security.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server身份验证绕过漏洞（CVSS 8.0）可能允许攻击者通过网络提升权限，威胁核心邮件基础设施安全。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Server allows remote code execution, a historically high-value target for attackers.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server中存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，该产品历来是攻击者的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft SharePoint allows authenticated attackers to execute code over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint中存在不可信数据反序列化漏洞，允许经过身份验证的攻击者通过网络执行代码。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), this MLflow vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass webhook URL validation and achieve remote code execution via SSRF.
items.reason_zh: 该MLflow漏洞正被在野利用（已列入CISA KEV），允许未经身份验证的攻击者绕过Webhook URL验证，并通过SSRF实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: SQL injection and command injection in Termix-SSH web-based server management platform allows full system compromise and unauthorized tunnel manipulation.
items.reason_zh: 基于Web的服务器管理平台Termix-SSH中存在SQL注入与命令注入漏洞，可导致系统被完全攻陷及未授权的隧道操作。

items.reason_en: ICEcoder suffers from an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw chained through authentication bypass, CSRF bypass, and unsanitized command execution.
items.reason_zh: ICEcoder中存在未经身份验证的远程代码执行漏洞，该漏洞由身份验证绕过、CSRF绕过和未过滤的命令执行漏洞链式利用而成。

items.reason_en: An authorization bypass in Etherpad's OAuth implementation allows attackers to access admin API endpoints by merely presenting an existing admin claim.
items.reason_zh: Etherpad的OAuth实现中存在授权绕过漏洞，攻击者只需提供现有的管理员声明即可访问管理员API端点。

items.reason_en: A critical PHP Object Injection vulnerability in the Flexible Subscriptions plugin allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Flexible Subscriptions插件中存在严重的PHP对象注入漏洞，允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Elementor Pro contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that allows attackers to upload malicious files and compromise the web server.
items.reason_zh: Elementor Pro包含无限制文件上传漏洞，允许攻击者上传恶意文件并控制Web服务器。

items.reason_en: The TrueBooker WordPress plugin lacks authentication checks on an AJAX handler, leading to complete account takeover.
items.reason_zh: TrueBooker WordPress插件的AJAX处理程序缺乏身份验证检查，导致账户被完全接管。

items.reason_en: The Formie plugin for Craft CMS passes user-controlled input to the Twig rendering layer, resulting in server-side template injection and RCE.
items.reason_zh: Craft CMS的Formie插件将用户控制的输入传递给Twig渲染层，导致服务器端模板注入和RCE。

items.reason_en: The Grav API Plugin fails to restrict webhook URL protocols, allowing SSRF and potential remote code execution via cURL.
items.reason_zh: Grav API Plugin未能限制webhook URL协议，允许通过cURL进行SSRF和潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A CVSS 8.5 cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Grav Shortcode Core Plugin that bypasses built-in XSS detection.
items.reason_zh: Grav Shortcode Core Plugin中存在CVSS评分为8.5的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可绕过内置的XSS检测。

items.reason_en: A severe type confusion vulnerability in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows unauthorized remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: 基于Chromium的Microsoft Edge中存在严重的类型混淆漏洞，允许未经授权的攻击者通过网络执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: An untrusted pointer dereference in Microsoft Edge allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge中存在不可信指针解引用漏洞，允许未经授权的攻击者通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Part of the infamous ProxyLogon exploit chain in Microsoft Exchange Server, this vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞是Microsoft Exchange Server中臭名昭著的ProxyLogon漏洞利用链的一部分，在野外被积极利用以实现未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A known exploited weak authentication flaw in Microsoft SharePoint that allows unauthorized attackers to bypass security features and access sensitive web resources.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint中存在已知被利用的弱身份验证缺陷，允许未经授权的攻击者绕过安全功能并访问敏感的Web资源。

items.reason_en: A cross-site scripting vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint that could allow attackers to perform spoofing and hijack user sessions in enterprise web portals.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint中存在跨站脚本漏洞，可能允许攻击者在企业Web门户中执行欺骗并劫持用户会话。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) causing network-based denial of service on web identity endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS)中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，导致Web身份端点遭受基于网络的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: A combination of XSS and CSRF vulnerabilities in Power BI Report Server that allows attackers to execute malicious scripts and forge requests.
items.reason_zh: Power BI Report Server中存在XSS和CSRF组合漏洞，允许攻击者执行恶意脚本并伪造请求。

items.reason_en: An actively exploited critical CVSS 9.8 deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint allowing unauthenticated remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint中存在被积极利用的严重反序列化漏洞（CVSS评分9.8），允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A known exploited remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server that frequently serves as an initial access vector for threat actors.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server中存在已知被利用的远程代码执行漏洞，经常被威胁行为者用作初始访问向量。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server, a critical target for enterprise email compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server中存在被积极利用的远程代码执行漏洞，是企业邮件系统被攻陷的关键目标。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited deserialization flaw in Microsoft Office SharePoint allowing unauthorized remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中存在被积极利用的反序列化缺陷，允许未经授权的攻击者通过网络执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited (CISA KEV), this MSHTML Framework protection mechanism failure allows attackers to bypass security features over a network.
items.reason_zh: 该MSHTML Framework保护机制失效漏洞被积极利用（已列入CISA KEV），允许攻击者通过网络绕过安全功能。

items.reason_en: Resource allocation without limits in ASP.NET Core allows unauthorized attackers to cause denial of service over the network.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中存在无限制资源分配漏洞，允许未经授权的攻击者通过网络引发拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution vulnerability in Oracle Siebel CRM Integration allowing unauthenticated attackers to compromise the web application.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Siebel CRM Integration中存在严重的远程代码执行漏洞，允许未经身份验证的攻击者控制Web应用程序。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in ASP.NET Core due to assumed-immutable data, allowing authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中由于假定数据不可变而导致身份验证绕过，允许已授权攻击者通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: The Zoo extension for Joomla suffers from an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability due to improper MIME type validation. This allows attackers to upload malicious files and achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Joomla的Zoo扩展由于MIME类型验证不当，存在未经身份验证的任意文件上传漏洞。这允许攻击者上传恶意文件并实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: J-BusinessDirectory for Joomla contains a path traversal and arbitrary file upload flaw. Attackers can upload or delete files outside the intended directory, leading to full site compromise.
items.reason_zh: Joomla的J-BusinessDirectory包含路径遍历和任意文件上传缺陷。攻击者可以在预期目录之外上传或删除文件，导致整个站点被控制。

items.reason_en: Maps Marker Pro for WordPress contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability. This allows remote attackers to extract sensitive database contents without authentication.
items.reason_zh: WordPress的Maps Marker Pro包含未经身份验证的SQL注入漏洞。这允许远程攻击者在无需身份验证的情况下提取敏感的数据库内容。

items.reason_en: The Phoca Downloads Joomla extension allows authenticated users to upload executable files. This leads to remote code execution on the underlying web server.
items.reason_zh: Joomla的Phoca Downloads扩展允许已认证用户上传可执行文件。这会导致底层Web服务器执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: A pre-authentication PHP code injection vulnerability in the Balbooa Forms Joomla extension allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via the eval() function.
items.reason_zh: Joomla的Balbooa Forms扩展中存在身份验证前PHP代码注入漏洞，允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过eval()函数执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: The YOOtheme Zoo extension for Joomla contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability, allowing attackers to extract or manipulate database contents.
items.reason_zh: Joomla的YOOtheme Zoo扩展包含未经身份验证的SQL注入漏洞，允许攻击者提取或操纵数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Grav CMS fails to restrict access to the admin.super field in group blueprints, allowing delegated administrators to escalate privileges to super-admin.
items.reason_zh: Grav CMS未能限制对组蓝图中admin.super字段的访问，允许委派管理员将权限提升至超级管理员。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in a widely used WordPress plugin poses an immediate and severe risk to web servers.
items.reason_zh: 一款广泛使用的WordPress插件中存在未经身份验证的远程代码执行漏洞，对Web服务器构成直接且严重的风险。

items.reason_en: A prototype pollution gadget in the popular Axios HTTP client can be chained to achieve full Man-in-the-Middle attacks on application traffic.
items.reason_zh: 流行的 Axios HTTP 客户端中的原型污染利用组件可被链接利用，从而对应用流量实施完整的中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Critical sanitization bypass allows attacker-controlled content to execute as live HTML, leading to severe Cross-Site Scripting attacks.
items.reason_zh: 严重的净化绕过漏洞允许攻击者控制的内容作为动态 HTML 执行，从而导致严重的跨站脚本攻击。

items.reason_en: A critical sandbox escape in the vm2 Node.js library allows malicious code to break out and execute arbitrary commands on the host system.
items.reason_zh: vm2 Node.js 库中存在严重的沙箱逃逸漏洞，允许恶意代码突破沙箱并在主机系统上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Joomla's failure to block SHTML file uploads allows attackers to achieve remote code execution on servers configured to execute these files.
items.reason_zh: Joomla 未能阻止 SHTML 文件上传，允许攻击者在配置为执行此类文件的服务器上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: An unauthenticated attacker can bypass intended checks in Keycloak's reset-credentials flow to force password resets for any user.
items.reason_zh: 未经身份验证的攻击者可以绕过 Keycloak 重置凭证流程中的预期检查，强制重置任何用户的密码。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution via insecure pickle deserialization in LMDeploy AI middleware (CVSS 9.8).
items.reason_zh: LMDeploy AI 中间件中存在不安全的 pickle 反序列化导致的严重远程代码执行漏洞（CVSS 9.8）。

items.reason_en: Severe exposure of session material in Splunk Enterprise (CVSS 9.4) allowing unauthenticated users to compromise system integrity.
items.reason_zh: Splunk Enterprise 中存在严重的会话凭据泄露漏洞（CVSS 9.4），允许未经身份验证的用户破坏系统完整性。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Entra Connect Sync (CVSS 7.8) allows privilege escalation, threatening the integrity of identity synchronization middleware.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra Connect Sync 中的 SQL 注入漏洞（CVSS 7.8）允许权限提升，威胁身份同步中间件的完整性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (on-premises) allows remote code execution in enterprise middleware.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365（本地部署）中存在不可信数据反序列化漏洞，允许在企业中间件中执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: A critical flaw in the Netty network application framework's TLS handshake processing can cause memory corruption or denial of service, affecting numerous downstream Java applications.
items.reason_zh: Netty 网络应用框架的 TLS 握手处理中存在严重缺陷，可能导致内存损坏或拒绝服务，影响众多下游 Java 应用。

items.reason_en: Improper restriction of communication channels in Azure SQL Managed Instance allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Managed Instance 中对通信通道的限制不当，允许未经授权的攻击者通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: A maximum severity vulnerability in Grafana's SCIM provisioning allows unauthorized user lifecycle management and potential privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Grafana 的 SCIM 预配中存在最高严重级别的漏洞，允许未经授权的用户生命周期管理和潜在的权限提升。

items.reason_en: A chained attack utilizing SQL Expressions and a Grafana Enterprise plugin leads to remote arbitrary code execution on the server.
items.reason_zh: 利用 SQL Expressions 和 Grafana Enterprise 插件的链式攻击可导致在服务器上远程执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: A confused-deputy flaw in Grafana MCP Server enables unauthenticated attackers to exfiltrate service-account tokens and perform SSRF attacks.
items.reason_zh: Grafana MCP Server 中的混淆代理缺陷使未经身份验证的攻击者能够窃取服务账户令牌并执行 SSRF 攻击。

items.reason_en: Oracle WebLogic Server is vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution via T3 and IIOP protocols, posing a severe risk to enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Oracle WebLogic Server 容易受到通过 T3 和 IIOP 协议进行的未经身份验证的远程代码执行攻击，对企业环境构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Oracle Identity Manager's Legacy UI contains an easily exploitable flaw allowing unauthenticated attackers to compromise the identity management system.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Identity Manager 的 Legacy UI 包含一个易于利用的缺陷，允许未经身份验证的攻击者攻陷身份管理系统。

items.reason_en: A low-privileged attacker can exploit the Composer component in Oracle WebCenter Portal to achieve remote code execution and compromise the portal.
items.reason_zh: 低权限攻击者可以利用 Oracle WebCenter Portal 中的 Composer 组件实现远程代码执行并攻陷该门户。

items.reason_en: A remote code execution vulnerability in the Windows Jet Database Engine with a high EPSS score, threatening systems processing malicious database files.
items.reason_zh: Windows Jet Database Engine 中存在具有高 EPSS 评分的远程代码执行漏洞，威胁处理恶意数据库文件的系统。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse allowing authorized attackers to execute code remotely.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse 中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许已授权攻击者远程执行代码。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), this Microsoft Exchange Server RCE vulnerability is critical for enterprise email infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 该 Microsoft Exchange Server RCE 漏洞正被在野积极利用（已列入 CISA KEV），对企业电子邮件基础设施影响重大。

items.reason_en: A type confusion vulnerability in .NET Core allows unauthorized attackers to cause a denial of service over the network.
items.reason_zh: .NET Core 中的类型混淆漏洞允许未经授权的攻击者通过网络导致拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: A critical deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft Dynamics NAV allowing unauthenticated remote code execution on enterprise ERP and middleware systems.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics NAV 中存在严重的反序列化漏洞，允许在企业 ERP 和中间件系统上进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: An SQL injection vulnerability in Microsoft SQL Server that allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network, directly threatening database integrity.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许已授权攻击者通过网络提升权限，直接威胁数据库完整性。

items.reason_en: A deserialization of untrusted data flaw in .NET that can lead to code execution, affecting numerous enterprise middleware and backend applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中存在不可信数据反序列化缺陷，可能导致代码执行，影响众多企业中间件和后端应用。

items.reason_en: A high severity remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft SQL Server that could lead to complete database compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中存在高严重级别的远程代码执行漏洞，可能导致数据库被完全攻陷。

items.reason_en: Critical deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in SQL Server allowing authorized attackers to execute code over the network.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中存在严重的不可信数据反序列化漏洞，允许已授权攻击者通过网络执行代码。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution vulnerability in the Microsoft WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL Server, risking database middleware compromise.
items.reason_zh: 用于 SQL Server 的 Microsoft WDAC OLE DB provider 中存在远程代码执行漏洞，存在数据库中间件被攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Critical CVSS 9.6 cross-site scripting vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server allows unauthorized spoofing over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中存在 CVSS 9.6 的严重跨站脚本漏洞，允许未经授权的网络欺骗。

items.reason_en: High-severity heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Server enables authorized attackers to execute code remotely.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中存在高严重级别的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，使已授权攻击者能够远程执行代码。

items.reason_en: Critical heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server ODBC driver allowing unauthenticated remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server ODBC driver 中存在严重的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许通过网络进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Maximum severity vulnerability in Oracle BI Publisher Web Service API allowing low-privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code via SOAP.
items.reason_zh: Oracle BI Publisher Web Service API 中存在最高严重性漏洞，允许低权限攻击者通过 SOAP 执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: High-severity flaw in Oracle Database Portable Clusterware allowing unauthenticated attackers on the physical network segment to compromise the database cluster.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Database Portable Clusterware 中存在高危漏洞，允许物理网段上的未授权攻击者破坏数据库集群。

items.reason_en: Oracle Helidon's Imperative Web Server contains multiple critical vulnerabilities allowing unauthenticated remote compromise. Attackers can exploit these flaws via HTTP to take full control of the middleware.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Helidon 的 Imperative Web Server 包含多个严重漏洞，允许未授权的远程攻击。攻击者可通过 HTTP 利用这些漏洞完全控制中间件。

items.reason_en: The RabbitMQ Java client library is vulnerable to a memory allocation flaw via malicious wire-declared content lengths. This can lead to denial of service by exhausting JVM memory.
items.reason_zh: RabbitMQ Java 客户端库存在内存分配缺陷，可通过恶意的协议声明内容长度触发。这会耗尽 JVM 内存从而导致拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: ArcadeDB fails to enforce permission checks when defining functions in existing libraries. Unauthorized users can overwrite SQL or Cypher functions to execute arbitrary database operations.
items.reason_zh: ArcadeDB 在现有库中定义函数时未强制执行权限检查。未授权用户可覆盖 SQL 或 Cypher 函数以执行任意数据库操作。

items.reason_en: A critical vulnerability in Oracle WebCenter Enterprise Capture allows unauthenticated remote attackers to compromise the system via HTTP, posing a severe risk to enterprise middleware deployments.
items.reason_zh: Oracle WebCenter Enterprise Capture 中存在严重漏洞，允许未授权的远程攻击者通过 HTTP 破坏系统，对企业中间件部署构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: ArcadeDB's Gremlin query engine silently falls back to an insecure Groovy engine, allowing authenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: ArcadeDB 的 Gremlin 查询引擎会静默回退到不安全的 Groovy 引擎，允许已授权攻击者实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: An integer overflow in DragonflyDB's CMS.INITBYDIM command leads to an undersized buffer allocation, potentially causing memory corruption and denial of service.
items.reason_zh: DragonflyDB 的 CMS.INITBYDIM 命令中存在整数溢出，导致分配的缓冲区过小，可能引发内存损坏和拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable unauthenticated vulnerability in Oracle Helidon allows complete compromise of the middleware via HTTP.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Helidon 中存在易于利用的未授权漏洞，允许通过 HTTP 完全控制中间件。

items.reason_en: Severe flaw in the Undertow HTTP server used in WildFly and JBoss fails to validate Host headers, enabling request smuggling or routing attacks.
items.reason_zh: WildFly 和 JBoss 使用的 Undertow HTTP 服务器存在严重缺陷，未验证 Host 标头，从而导致请求走私或路由攻击。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free vulnerability in Valkey's RESTORE command can be triggered by authenticated clients to crash the database or potentially execute code.
items.reason_zh: Valkey 的 RESTORE 命令中存在释放后使用漏洞，已授权客户端可触发该漏洞使数据库崩溃或潜在执行代码。

items.reason_en: A format string injection in Ruby's JSON parser can lead to denial of service or information disclosure when processing untrusted JSON data.
items.reason_zh: Ruby 的 JSON 解析器中存在格式化字符串注入漏洞，在处理不受信任的 JSON 数据时可能导致拒绝服务或信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft High Performance Computing (HPC) Pack allows unauthenticated remote code execution across high-performance compute clusters.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft High Performance Computing (HPC) Pack 中存在不受信任数据反序列化漏洞，允许在高性能计算集群中进行未授权的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: An authentication bypass in IBM Power Systems Firmware FSP management network protocol allows unauthenticated attackers to gain full administrative access to the hardware management console.
items.reason_zh: IBM Power Systems Firmware FSP 管理网络协议中存在身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未授权攻击者获得对硬件管理控制台的完全管理访问权限。

items.reason_en: A critical stack buffer overflow in IBM AIX and PowerVM VIOS allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on the enterprise OS and hypervisor.
items.reason_zh: IBM AIX 和 PowerVM VIOS 中存在严重的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者在企业操作系统和虚拟机管理程序上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: An attacker with root access to an IBM PowerVM guest partition can exploit the hypervisor call interface to inject code into the host hypervisor.
items.reason_zh: 拥有 IBM PowerVM 客户机分区 root 访问权限的攻击者可利用虚拟机管理程序调用接口向主机虚拟机管理程序注入代码。

items.reason_en: A vulnerability in the IBM Power Systems Firmware BMC interface allows attackers with service access to execute arbitrary code on the host system.
items.reason_zh: IBM Power Systems Firmware BMC 接口中存在漏洞，允许具有服务访问权限的攻击者在主机系统上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: FFmpeg contains a critical heap buffer overflow in the RIST protocol reader that can be triggered by processing malicious network streams.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg 的 RIST 协议读取器中存在严重的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过处理恶意网络流触发。

items.reason_en: A CVSS 9.8 buffer overflow vulnerability in the libiscsi_tcp SCSI response handling, critical for storage area network security.
items.reason_zh: libiscsi_tcp 的 SCSI 响应处理中存在 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的缓冲区溢出漏洞，对存储区域网络安全至关重要。

items.reason_en: A command injection vulnerability in Windows Admin Center allows authorized attackers to execute code over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows Admin Center 中存在命令注入漏洞，允许已授权攻击者通过网络执行代码。

items.reason_en: Inclusion of functionality from an untrusted control sphere in Visual Studio Code allows attackers to bypass security features.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中包含了来自不受信任控制域的功能，允许攻击者绕过安全特性。

items.reason_en: A critical remote code execution flaw in Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server, posing a high risk to widely deployed public and private gaming infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server 中存在严重的远程代码执行缺陷，对广泛部署的公共和私有游戏基础设施构成高风险。

items.reason_en: An improper restriction vulnerability in GitHub Copilot that could lead to local code execution, highlighting emerging risks in AI-assisted development tools.
items.reason_zh: GitHub Copilot 中存在限制不当漏洞，可能导致本地代码执行，凸显了 AI 辅助开发工具中的新兴风险。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in FFmpeg DASH demuxer, posing risks to applications and services relying on FFmpeg for media parsing.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg DASH 解复用器中存在越界读取漏洞，对依赖 FFmpeg 进行媒体解析的应用程序和服务构成风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in the Visual Studio Code extension for Arduino allows unauthenticated remote code execution, impacting developer and IoT environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 的 Arduino 扩展中缺少身份验证，允许未授权的远程代码执行，影响开发者和物联网环境。

items.reason_en: A heap buffer overflow in FFmpeg's RTP packetizer that could lead to memory corruption and code execution in multimedia processing applications.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg 的 RTP 打包器中存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可能导致多媒体处理应用程序中的内存损坏和代码执行。

items.reason_en: High-severity relative path traversal in Age of Empires II allows unauthorized remote code execution, affecting gaming environments.
items.reason_zh: Age of Empires II 中存在高危相对路径遍历漏洞，允许未授权的远程代码执行，影响游戏环境。

items.reason_en: Critical path traversal vulnerability in Wazuh cluster synchronization allowing attackers to overwrite arbitrary files and compromise the security monitoring platform.
items.reason_zh: Wazuh 集群同步中存在严重的路径遍历漏洞，允许攻击者覆盖任意文件并破坏安全监控平台。

items.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow in FFmpeg MPEG-PS muxer that can be triggered by crafted media files, posing a risk to applications processing untrusted video inputs.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg MPEG-PS 复用器中存在栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过特制媒体文件触发，对处理不受信任视频输入的应用程序构成风险。

items.reason_en: Context7 contains a prompt injection vulnerability in its Custom AI Instructions feature. Attackers can poison instructions to execute malicious commands in connected AI coding agents.
items.reason_zh: Context7 的 Custom AI Instructions 功能中存在提示词注入漏洞。攻击者可污染指令以在连接的 AI 编码代理中执行恶意命令。

items.reason_en: GitPython is vulnerable to remote code execution due to unsafe git options being forwarded during repository initialization. Attackers can supply malicious templates to execute arbitrary code via git hooks.
items.reason_zh: GitPython 在仓库初始化期间因传递不安全的 git 选项而存在远程代码执行漏洞。攻击者可通过提供恶意模板，利用 git hooks 执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: GitPython contains a config-name injection vulnerability that allows attackers to forge arbitrary git-config directives and potentially execute malicious commands during repository operations.
items.reason_zh: GitPython 存在 config-name 注入漏洞，允许攻击者伪造任意 git-config 指令，并可能在仓库操作期间执行恶意命令。

items.reason_en: Renovate contains a command injection vulnerability in the helmv3 manager's registryAliases handling, allowing attackers with commit access to execute arbitrary commands in the CI/CD pipeline.
items.reason_zh: Renovate 的 helmv3 管理器在处理 registryAliases 时存在命令注入漏洞，允许具有提交权限的攻击者在 CI/CD 流水线中执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Race condition in rsync daemon file handling allows attackers with write access to redirect file writes outside intended directories via symlinks.
items.reason_zh: rsync 守护进程在文件处理中存在竞争条件漏洞，允许具有写入权限的攻击者利用符号链接将文件写入操作重定向至预期目录之外。

items.reason_en: An out-of-bounds memory access in FFmpeg's RASC video decoder could be exploited via maliciously crafted video files to crash applications or leak memory.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg 的 RASC 视频解码器存在越界内存访问漏洞，攻击者可通过特制的恶意视频文件利用该漏洞导致应用程序崩溃或内存泄漏。

items.reason_en: An integer overflow leading to a double-free condition in libarchive's RAR processing can cause memory corruption when handling malicious archives.
items.reason_zh: libarchive 的 RAR 处理逻辑中存在整数溢出漏洞，可导致双重释放问题，在处理恶意压缩包时会引发内存损坏。
